entities.name: Bronze & Iron Age Estonia
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The emergence of fortified hillforts (linnamägi), amber trade routes, and contacts with Scandinavian and Baltic peoples. Iron Age ship burials at Salme (c. 750 AD) reveal Viking-age warrior culture among Estonians.
